text:
alex.marketing: Hey team — upcoming webinar (Apr 18). Need a small launch creative pack focused on inference economics: one modular benchmark graphic, 3 social-ready tiles, a compact one-pager, and an email header. Emma, can you lead design + brand sign-off?

emma.design: on it. do we have the final benchmark figures and preferred tone (technical vs high-level)? also any hard brand rules I should follow?

leo.product: Sharing the vetted numbers: "3.3x median throughput vs baseline", "42% token cost reduction", "p95 latency ≈95ms". Tone: product-savvy but non-jargon. Avoid model names.

alex.marketing: Headline draft: "Inference you can budget for". Subhead: "Predictable performance, lower unit cost". Two CTAs: "Register now" and "Talk to sales". Short copy for paid: <=35 chars. Long copy for landing: ~120 chars.

claire.demand: For paid social keep headline <=30 chars for creative safety. Need 2 variants of alt-copy: inbound (mid-market) and enterprise (security/SLAs focus).

legal-bot: Reminder: Do not include third-party logos or benchmark screenshots. Use approved palette and icons only. Add short legal footer: "Redwood Inference — hosted, dedicated, private". Accessibility: include alt text for every image.

emma.design: Plan: modular Figma with artboards for each format so we can crop/reuse. Posting initial mock by Tue EOD, review Wed AM. Deliverables list (pasting spec):
```
Deliverables:
- benchmark module (responsive SVG + 1200x628 PNG)
- social tiles (1080x1080) x3: hero, stat callout, CTA
- one-pager PDF A4 300dpi (includes TL;DR metrics + 3 callouts)
- email header 600x200 PNG + 2 alt text variants
- source: Figma file + flattened PNG/JPEG/SVGs
- naming: redwood_bench_YYYYMMDD_variant.png
```

figma-bot: emma.design uploaded: /files/visuals/1778304000-compact-launch-kit-v1.fig

claire.demand: tagging demand-gen — can you review paid specs? Also suggest landing copy A/B for enterprise vs inbound.

alex.marketing: timeline: mock Tue EOD, internal review Wed AM, legal check Wed PM, final assets by next Mon COB. Localization: start EN + ES. We'll add FR later.

emma.design: noted. I'll include a quick QA checklist in Figma for colors, contrast, alt text, and export sizes. Flagging now if anyone objects to ES localization or needs additional variants. :eyes:

leo.product: no objections. thanks all.

alex.marketing: great — ping here when mock is up and I'll route to webinar page content. :rocket:
